title: LGBTQIA+ News, Earthquake Movement Caught On Video, and Wallace and Grombit Real Life Invention
content:
MetaFilter] LGBTQIA+ News Roundup – May 12, 2025 A semi-regular overview of recent wins and setbacks from around the world in the LGBTQIA+ community. Compiled and share by mephron.

Caught on Camera: The First-Ever Clear Footage of a Fault Line Shifting If you've ever fallen down an earthquake video rabbit hole on YouTube, you've seen it all. But here's something new: clear, real-time footage of a fault line visibly shifting the entire landscape. Not just shaking—moving! Shared by Rhaomi.

:emoji:️ Real-Life Wallace & Gromit Machine? Yes, Please! Joseph's Machines is making your dreams come true (and then some). In his latest video, he creates a real-life Wallace & Gromit–style invention, and it's pure, jam-covered joy. Shared by Pitachu.
author: Brandon Blatcher
